mentions.name: WC Price Hostory
mentions.description: A WooCommerce plugin that handles price tracking and Omnibus Directive compliance for e-commerce stores. Available as a free tool for years with over 45k active installs, it now offers a Pro extension with more advanced features.
mentions.problem: E-commerce stores in Europe must stay compliant with the EU Omnibus Directive on price display.
mentions.audience: E-commerce store owners running WooCommerce in Europe who need to stay compliant with EU law
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on WC Price Hostory, a plugin that handles price tracking and Omnibus Directive compliance for WooCommerce.
